+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
+                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
+        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
+        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
+                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
+        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
+    }
 }
 
+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
+    }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
+}

+std::vector<double> gatherConcentration(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration,
+                                        const std::size_t plane, const std::size_t nz,
+                                        const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<double> globalConcentration;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+            const Slab sourceSlab = decomposeZ(nz, source, ranks);
+            const std::size_t count = sourceSlab.localNz * plane;
+            const std::size_t displacement = sourceSlab.globalZOffset * plane;
+            if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX) ||
+                displacement > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+                MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            }
+            counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(displacement);
+        }
+        globalConcentration.resize(plane * nz);
+    }
+
+    if (localConcentration.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "Local result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(localConcentration.data(), static_cast<int>(localConcentration.size()),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, rank == 0 ? globalConcentration.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return globalConcentration;
+}

namespace {

constexpr int THREADS_PER_BLOCK = 256;
constexpr int LOWER_TAG = 4100;
constexpr int UPPER_TAG = 4101;

void mpiCheck(const int error, const char* expression, const char* file, const int line) {
    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) {
        return;
    }

    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
    int length = 0;
    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
    int rank = -1;
    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: MPI error at %s:%d in %s: %.*s\n",
                 rank, file, line, expression, length, message);
    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
}

void cudaCheck(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const char* file, const int line) {
    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
        return;
    }

    int rank = -1;
    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));
    return exchange;
}

void finishHaloExchange(HaloRequests& exchange, double* field,
                        const std::size_t plane, const Slab& slab,
                        cudaStream_t stream) {
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(4, exchange.requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));

    // MPI_PROC_NULL leaves a ghost plane untouched, so reproduce the original
    // clamped z boundary by copying the nearest physical plane.
    if (slab.lowerRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, plane * sizeof(double),
                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
    }
    if (slab.upperRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (slab.localNz + 1) * plane,
                                   field + slab.localNz * plane,
                                   plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
    }
}

void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
    }
}

bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
    int localInvalid = 0;
    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());

#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
    }

    double globalMin = 0.0;
    double globalMax = 0.0;
    int globalInvalid = 0;
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));

    if (rank == 0) {
        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
        }
        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
        }
    }
    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
}

std::vector<double> gatherConcentration(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration,
                                        const std::size_t plane, const std::size_t nz,
                                        const int rank, const int ranks) {
    std::vector<int> counts;
    std::vector<int> displacements;
    std::vector<double> globalConcentration;
    if (rank == 0) {
        counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
        for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
            const Slab sourceSlab = decomposeZ(nz, source, ranks);
            const std::size_t count = sourceSlab.localNz * plane;
            const std::size_t displacement = sourceSlab.globalZOffset * plane;
            if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX) ||
                displacement > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "Result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
                MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
            counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(count);
            displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(displacement);
        }
        globalConcentration.resize(plane * nz);
    }

    if (localConcentration.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
        if (rank == 0) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "Local result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
        }
        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(localConcentration.data(), static_cast<int>(localConcentration.size()),
                          MPI_DOUBLE, rank == 0 ? globalConcentration.data() : nullptr,
                          rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
                          rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
    return globalConcentration;
}

} // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    int provided = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided));

    int rank = 0;
    int ranks = 1;
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank));
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks));
    if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
        if (rank == 0) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI does not provide the required MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED support\n");
        }
        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
        // Ensure the previous update is visible before CUDA-aware MPI reads it.
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream));
        HaloRequests concentrationExchange =
            postHaloExchange(deviceConcentration, plane, slab.localNz, slab);

        // z=[2, localNz) never consumes a ghost plane and overlaps halo traffic.
        launchChemical(deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny, 2,
                       slab.localNz, invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, gamma,
                       linearCoefficient, constantCoefficient,
                       deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
        finishHaloExchange(concentrationExchange, deviceConcentration, plane, slab, computeStream);
        launchChemical(deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny, 1, 2,
                       invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, gamma, linearCoefficient,
                       constantCoefficient, deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
        if (slab.localNz > 1) {
            launchChemical(deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny,
                           slab.localNz, slab.localNz + 1, invDx2, invDy2,
                           invDz2, gamma, linearCoefficient, constantCoefficient,
                           deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
        }

        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream));
        HaloRequests potentialExchange =
            postHaloExchange(deviceChemicalPotential, plane, slab.localNz, slab);

        launchUpdate(deviceNext, deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential,
                     nx, ny, 2, slab.localNz, invDx2, invDy2, invDz2,
                     dt * diffusion, deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
        finishHaloExchange(potentialExchange, deviceChemicalPotential, plane, slab, computeStream);
        launchUpdate(deviceNext, deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential,
                     nx, ny, 1, 2, invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dt * diffusion,
                     deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
        if (slab.localNz > 1) {
            launchUpdate(deviceNext, deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential,
                         nx, ny, slab.localNz, slab.localNz + 1,
                         invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dt * diffusion,
                         deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
        }
        std::swap(deviceConcentration, deviceNext);
    }

    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream));
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
    double elapsed = 0.0;
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));

    if (rank == 0) {
        const long long milliseconds = static_cast<long long>(elapsed * 1000.0);
        const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(gridSize) * iterations;
        const double mcups = elapsed > 0.0 ? cellUpdates / elapsed / 1.0e6 : 0.0;
        std::printf("Computation time: %lld ms\n", milliseconds);
        std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
    }

    if (printResults || validate) {
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localConcentration.data(), deviceConcentration + plane,
                              localCells * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    }

    if (printResults) {
        std::vector<double> globalConcentration =
            gatherConcentration(localConcentration, plane, nz, rank, ranks);
        if (rank == 0) {
            print_results(globalConcentration, "Concentration");
        }
    }

    bool valid = true;
    if (validate) {
        if (rank == 0) {
            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
        }
        valid = validateDistributed(localConcentration, rank);
        if (rank == 0) {
            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
        }
    }

    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(computeStream));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceChemicalPotential));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceNext));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceConcentration));
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator));
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
    return valid ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
}

+Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
+    return {localNz, offset,
+            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
+            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};

+// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
+// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                                        const double invDx2, const double invDy2,
+                                        const double invDz2, const double gamma,
+                                        const double linearCoefficient,
+                                        const double constantCoefficient) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * plane;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+
+    for (std::size_t cell = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         cell < cells; cell += stride) {
+        const std::size_t inPlane = cell % plane;
+        const std::size_t x = inPlane % nx;
+        const std::size_t z = zBegin + cell / plane;
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = inPlane < nx ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = inPlane + nx >= plane ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) * invDx2 +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) * invDy2 +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value) * invDz2;
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            value * value * value + linearCoefficient * value + constantCoefficient - gamma * laplacian;
+    }
+}

+int launchBlockCount(const std::size_t cells, const int multiprocessors) {
+    const std::size_t required = (cells + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK;
+    const std::size_t occupancyCap = static_cast<std::size_t>(multiprocessors) * 8;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<std::size_t>(1, std::min(required, occupancyCap)));
+}
+
+void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
+                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                    const double invDx2, const double invDy2, const double invDz2,
+                    const double gamma, const double linearCoefficient,
+                    const double constantCoefficient, const int multiprocessors,
+                    cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, gamma, linearCoefficient, constantCoefficient);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const double invDx2,
+                  const double invDy2, const double invDz2,
+                  const double dtTimesD, const int multiprocessors,
+                  cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    updateKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dtTimesD);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}

+struct HaloRequests {
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+};
+
+HaloRequests postHaloExchange(double* field, const std::size_t plane,
+                              const std::size_t localNz, const Slab& slab) {
+    HaloRequests exchange{};
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(field, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, UPPER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[0]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                        slab.upperRank, LOWER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[1]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(field + plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, LOWER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[2]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(field + localNz * plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank,
+                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));
+    return exchange;
+}
+
+void finishHaloExchange(HaloRequests& exchange, double* field,
+                        const std::size_t plane, const Slab& slab,
+                        cudaStream_t stream) {
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(4, exchange.requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+
+    // MPI_PROC_NULL leaves a ghost plane untouched, so reproduce the original
+    // clamped z boundary by copying the nearest physical plane.
+    if (slab.lowerRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, plane * sizeof(double),
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
     }

-    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds
-    if (maxVal > 10.0 || minVal < -10.0) {
-        printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
-        return false;

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (slab.localNz + 1) * plane,
+                                   field + slab.localNz * plane,
+                                   plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
     }

+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
+                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
+        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
+        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
+                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
+        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
+    }
 }
 
+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
+    }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
+}
+
+std::vector<double> gatherConcentration(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration,
+                                        const std::size_t plane, const std::size_t nz,
+                                        const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<double> globalConcentration;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+            const Slab sourceSlab = decomposeZ(nz, source, ranks);
+            const std::size_t count = sourceSlab.localNz * plane;
+            const std::size_t displacement = sourceSlab.globalZOffset * plane;
+            if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX) ||
+                displacement > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+                MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            }
+            counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(displacement);
+        }
+        globalConcentration.resize(plane * nz);
+    }
+
+    if (localConcentration.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "Local result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(localConcentration.data(), static_cast<int>(localConcentration.size()),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, rank == 0 ? globalConcentration.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return globalConcentration;
+}

   208	                  const double dtTimesD, const int multiprocessors,
   209	                  cudaStream_t stream) {
   210	    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
   211	        return;
   212	    }
   213	    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
   214	    updateKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
   215	        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
   216	        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dtTimesD);
   217	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
   218	}
   219	
   220	struct HaloRequests {
   221	    MPI_Request requests[4];
   222	};
   223	
   224	HaloRequests postHaloExchange(double* field, const std::size_t plane,
   225	                              const std::size_t localNz, const Slab& slab) {
   226	    HaloRequests exchange{};
   227	    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
   228	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(field, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, UPPER_TAG,
   229	                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[0]));
   230	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE,
   231	                        slab.upperRank, LOWER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[1]));
   232	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(field + plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, LOWER_TAG,
   233	                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[2]));
   234	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(field + localNz * plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank,
   235	                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));
   236	    return exchange;
   237	}
   238	
   239	void finishHaloExchange(HaloRequests& exchange, double* field,
   240	                        const std::size_t plane, const Slab& slab,
   241	                        cudaStream_t stream) {
   242	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(4, exchange.requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
   243	
   244	    // MPI_PROC_NULL leaves a ghost plane untouched, so reproduce the original
   245	    // clamped z boundary by copying the nearest physical plane.
   246	    if (slab.lowerRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   247	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, plane * sizeof(double),
   248	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
   249	    }
   250	    if (slab.upperRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   251	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (slab.localNz + 1) * plane,
   252	                                   field + slab.localNz * plane,
   253	                                   plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
   254	    }
   255	}
   256	
   257	void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
   258	                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
   259	                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
   260	    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
   261	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   262	    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
   263	        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
   264	        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
   265	                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
   266	        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
   267	    }
   268	}
   269	
   270	bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
   271	    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
   272	    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
   273	    int localInvalid = 0;
   274	    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
   275	
   276	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
   277	    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
   278	        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
   279	        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
   280	        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
   281	        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
   282	    }
   283	
   284	    double globalMin = 0.0;
   285	    double globalMax = 0.0;
   455	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   456	        std::printf("Hybrid execution: %d MPI rank(s), up to %d OpenMP thread(s)/rank, CUDA GPUs\n",
   457	                    ranks, omp_get_max_threads());
   458	        std::printf("Rank 0 CUDA device: %s\n", deviceProperties.name);
   459	        std::printf("Initializing concentration field...\n");
   460	    }
   461	
   462	    std::vector<double> localConcentration(localCells);
   463	    initializeConcentration(localConcentration, slab.globalZOffset * plane, gridSize);
   464	
   465	    double* deviceConcentration = nullptr;
   466	    double* deviceNext = nullptr;
   467	    double* deviceChemicalPotential = nullptr;
   468	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceConcentration, allocatedCells * sizeof(double)));
   469	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceNext, allocatedCells * sizeof(double)));
   470	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceChemicalPotential, allocatedCells * sizeof(double)));
   471	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceConcentration + plane, localConcentration.data(),
   472	                          localCells * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   473	
   474	    cudaStream_t computeStream = nullptr;
   475	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&computeStream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   476	
   477	    // Physical parameters and their precomputed stencil coefficients.
   478	    constexpr double dx = 1.0;
   479	    constexpr double dy = 1.0;
   480	    constexpr double dz = 1.0;
   481	    constexpr double dt = 0.01;
   482	    constexpr double eAA = -(2.0 / 9.0);
   483	    constexpr double eBB = -(2.0 / 9.0);
   484	    constexpr double eAB = (2.0 / 9.0);
   485	    constexpr double gamma = 0.5;
   486	    constexpr double diffusion = 1.0;
   487	    constexpr double invDx2 = 1.0 / (dx * dx);
   488	    constexpr double invDy2 = 1.0 / (dy * dy);
   489	    constexpr double invDz2 = 1.0 / (dz * dz);
   490	    constexpr double linearCoefficient = 4.5 * (eAA + eBB - 2.0 * eAB) + 3.0;
   491	    constexpr double constantCoefficient = 4.5 * (eAA - eBB);
   492	
   493	    if (rank == 0) {
   494	        std::printf("Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\n");
   495	    }
   496	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   497	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   498	
   499	    for (int step = 0; step < iterations; ++step) {
   500	        // Ensure the previous update is visible before CUDA-aware MPI reads it.
   501	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream));
   502	        HaloRequests concentrationExchange =
   503	            postHaloExchange(deviceConcentration, plane, slab.localNz, slab);
   504	
   505	        // z=[2, localNz) never consumes a ghost plane and overlaps halo traffic.
   506	        launchChemical(deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny, 2,
   507	                       slab.localNz, invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, gamma,
   508	                       linearCoefficient, constantCoefficient,
   509	                       deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
   510	        finishHaloExchange(concentrationExchange, deviceConcentration, plane, slab, computeStream);
   511	        launchChemical(deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny, 1, 2,
   512	                       invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, gamma, linearCoefficient,
   513	                       constantCoefficient, deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
   514	        if (slab.localNz > 1) {
   515	            launchChemical(deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny,
   516	                           slab.localNz, slab.localNz + 1, invDx2, invDy2,
   517	                           invDz2, gamma, linearCoefficient, constantCoefficient,
   518	                           deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
   519	        }
   520	
   521	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream));
   522	        HaloRequests potentialExchange =
   523	            postHaloExchange(deviceChemicalPotential, plane, slab.localNz, slab);
   524	
   525	        launchUpdate(deviceNext, deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential,
   526	                     nx, ny, 2, slab.localNz, invDx2, invDy2, invDz2,
   527	                     dt * diffusion, deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
   528	        finishHaloExchange(potentialExchange, deviceChemicalPotential, plane, slab, computeStream);
   529	        launchUpdate(deviceNext, deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential,
   530	                     nx, ny, 1, 2, invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dt * diffusion,
   531	                     deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
   532	        if (slab.localNz > 1) {
   533	            launchUpdate(deviceNext, deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential,
   534	                         nx, ny, slab.localNz, slab.localNz + 1,
   535	                         invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dt * diffusion,
   536	                         deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount, computeStream);
   537	        }
   538	        std::swap(deviceConcentration, deviceNext);
   539	    }
   540	
   541	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream));
   542	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   543	    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   544	    double elapsed = 0.0;
   545	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   546	
   547	    if (rank == 0) {
   548	        const long long milliseconds = static_cast<long long>(elapsed * 1000.0);
   549	        const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(gridSize) * iterations;
   550	        const double mcups = elapsed > 0.0 ? cellUpdates / elapsed / 1.0e6 : 0.0;
   551	        std::printf("Computation time: %lld ms\n", milliseconds);
   552	        std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   553	    }
   554	
   555	    if (printResults || validate) {
   556	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localConcentration.data(), deviceConcentration + plane,
   557	                              localCells * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   558	    }
   559	
   560	    if (printResults) {
   561	        std::vector<double> globalConcentration =
   562	            gatherConcentration(localConcentration, plane, nz, rank, ranks);
   563	        if (rank == 0) {
   564	            print_results(globalConcentration, "Concentration");
   565	        }
   566	    }
   567	
   568	    bool valid = true;
   569	    if (validate) {
   570	        if (rank == 0) {
   570	        if (rank == 0) {
   571	            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   572	        }
   573	        valid = validateDistributed(localConcentration, rank);
   574	        if (rank == 0) {
   575	            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   576	        }
   577	    }
   578	
   579	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(computeStream));
   580	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceChemicalPotential));
   581	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceNext));
   582	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceConcentration));
   583	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator));
   584	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   585	    return valid ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
   586	}

+struct Slab {
+    std::size_t localNz;
+    std::size_t globalZOffset;
+    int lowerRank;
+    int upperRank;
+};
+
+Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
+    return {localNz, offset,
+            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
+            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};
+}

+// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
+// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                                        const double invDx2, const double invDy2,
+                                        const double invDz2, const double gamma,
+                                        const double linearCoefficient,
+                                        const double constantCoefficient) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * plane;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+
+    for (std::size_t cell = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         cell < cells; cell += stride) {
+        const std::size_t inPlane = cell % plane;
+        const std::size_t x = inPlane % nx;
+        const std::size_t z = zBegin + cell / plane;
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = inPlane < nx ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = inPlane + nx >= plane ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) * invDx2 +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) * invDy2 +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value) * invDz2;
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            value * value * value + linearCoefficient * value + constantCoefficient - gamma * laplacian;
+    }
+}

+__global__ void updateKernel(double* __restrict__ nextConcentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                             const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                             const double invDx2, const double invDy2,
+                             const double invDz2, const double dtTimesD) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * plane;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+
+    for (std::size_t cell = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         cell < cells; cell += stride) {
+        const std::size_t inPlane = cell % plane;
+        const std::size_t x = inPlane % nx;
+        const std::size_t z = zBegin + cell / plane;
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = inPlane < nx ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = inPlane + nx >= plane ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = chemicalPotential[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (chemicalPotential[left] + chemicalPotential[right] - 2.0 * value) * invDx2 +
+            (chemicalPotential[down] + chemicalPotential[up] - 2.0 * value) * invDy2 +
+            (chemicalPotential[center - plane] + chemicalPotential[center + plane] - 2.0 * value) * invDz2;
+
+        nextConcentration[center] = concentration[center] + dtTimesD * laplacian;
     }
-    
-    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field
-    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded
-    double minVal = c[0];
-    double maxVal = c[0];
-    for (const auto& val : c) {
-        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);
-        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);
+}

+int launchBlockCount(const std::size_t cells, const int multiprocessors) {
+    const std::size_t required = (cells + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK;
+    const std::size_t occupancyCap = static_cast<std::size_t>(multiprocessors) * 8;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<std::size_t>(1, std::min(required, occupancyCap)));
+}
+
+void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
+                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                    const double invDx2, const double invDy2, const double invDz2,
+                    const double gamma, const double linearCoefficient,
+                    const double constantCoefficient, const int multiprocessors,
+                    cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, gamma, linearCoefficient, constantCoefficient);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const double invDx2,
+                  const double invDy2, const double invDz2,
+                  const double dtTimesD, const int multiprocessors,
+                  cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    updateKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dtTimesD);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}

+struct HaloRequests {
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+};
+
+HaloRequests postHaloExchange(double* field, const std::size_t plane,
+                              const std::size_t localNz, const Slab& slab) {
+    HaloRequests exchange{};
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(field, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, UPPER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[0]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                        slab.upperRank, LOWER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[1]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(field + plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, LOWER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[2]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(field + localNz * plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank,
+                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));
+    return exchange;
+}
+
+void finishHaloExchange(HaloRequests& exchange, double* field,
+                        const std::size_t plane, const Slab& slab,
+                        cudaStream_t stream) {
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(4, exchange.requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+
+    // MPI_PROC_NULL leaves a ghost plane untouched, so reproduce the original
+    // clamped z boundary by copying the nearest physical plane.
+    if (slab.lowerRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, plane * sizeof(double),
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
     }
-    
-    printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", minVal, maxVal);
-    
-    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds
-    if (maxVal > 10.0 || minVal < -10.0) {
-        printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
-        return false;
+    if (slab.upperRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (slab.localNz + 1) * plane,
+                                   field + slab.localNz * plane,
+                                   plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
     }
-    
-    return true;
 }

+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
+                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
+        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
+        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
+                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
+        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
+    }
 }
 
+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
+    }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
+}
+
+std::vector<double> gatherConcentration(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration,
+                                        const std::size_t plane, const std::size_t nz,
+                                        const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<double> globalConcentration;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+            const Slab sourceSlab = decomposeZ(nz, source, ranks);
+            const std::size_t count = sourceSlab.localNz * plane;
+            const std::size_t displacement = sourceSlab.globalZOffset * plane;
+            if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX) ||
+                displacement > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+                MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            }
+            counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(displacement);
+        }
+        globalConcentration.resize(plane * nz);
+    }
+
+    if (localConcentration.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "Local result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(localConcentration.data(), static_cast<int>(localConcentration.size()),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, rank == 0 ? globalConcentration.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return globalConcentration;
+}

+void mpiCheck(const int error, const char* expression, const char* file, const int line) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: MPI error at %s:%d in %s: %.*s\n",
+                 rank, file, line, expression, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

+void cudaCheck(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const char* file, const int line) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return;
+    }
+

+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d in %s: %s\n",
+                 rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(error));

+struct Slab {

+Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
+    return {localNz, offset,
+            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
+            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};
+}

+// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
+// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                                        const double invDx2, const double invDy2,
+                                        const double invDz2, const double gamma,
+                                        const double linearCoefficient,
+                                        const double constantCoefficient) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * plane;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+
+    for (std::size_t cell = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         cell < cells; cell += stride) {
+        const std::size_t inPlane = cell % plane;
+        const std::size_t x = inPlane % nx;
+        const std::size_t z = zBegin + cell / plane;
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = inPlane < nx ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = inPlane + nx >= plane ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) * invDx2 +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) * invDy2 +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value) * invDz2;
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            value * value * value + linearCoefficient * value + constantCoefficient - gamma * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(double* __restrict__ nextConcentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                             const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                             const double invDx2, const double invDy2,
+                             const double invDz2, const double dtTimesD) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * plane;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+
+    for (std::size_t cell = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         cell < cells; cell += stride) {
+        const std::size_t inPlane = cell % plane;
+        const std::size_t x = inPlane % nx;
+        const std::size_t z = zBegin + cell / plane;
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = inPlane < nx ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = inPlane + nx >= plane ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = chemicalPotential[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (chemicalPotential[left] + chemicalPotential[right] - 2.0 * value) * invDx2 +
+            (chemicalPotential[down] + chemicalPotential[up] - 2.0 * value) * invDy2 +
+            (chemicalPotential[center - plane] + chemicalPotential[center + plane] - 2.0 * value) * invDz2;
+
+        nextConcentration[center] = concentration[center] + dtTimesD * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+int launchBlockCount(const std::size_t cells, const int multiprocessors) {
+    const std::size_t required = (cells + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK;
+    const std::size_t occupancyCap = static_cast<std::size_t>(multiprocessors) * 8;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<std::size_t>(1, std::min(required, occupancyCap)));
+}
+
+void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
+                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                    const double invDx2, const double invDy2, const double invDz2,
+                    const double gamma, const double linearCoefficient,
+                    const double constantCoefficient, const int multiprocessors,
+                    cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, gamma, linearCoefficient, constantCoefficient);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const double invDx2,
+                  const double invDy2, const double invDz2,
+                  const double dtTimesD, const int multiprocessors,
+                  cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    updateKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dtTimesD);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());

+struct HaloRequests {

+HaloRequests postHaloExchange(double* field, const std::size_t plane,
+                              const std::size_t localNz, const Slab& slab) {
+    HaloRequests exchange{};
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(field, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, UPPER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[0]));

+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[2]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(field + localNz * plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank,
+                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));
+    return exchange;

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }

+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");

+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);

+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
     }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;

+void mpiCheck(const int error, const char* expression, const char* file, const int line) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: MPI error at %s:%d in %s: %.*s\n",
+                 rank, file, line, expression, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}
+
+void cudaCheck(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const char* file, const int line) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d in %s: %s\n",
+                 rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(error));
+}
+
+#define MPI_CHECK(call) mpiCheck((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) cudaCheck((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)
+
+bool checkedProduct(const std::size_t a, const std::size_t b, std::size_t& result) {
+    if (a != 0 && b > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / a) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    result = a * b;
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (text[0] == '-' || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool parseIterations(const char* text, int& value) {
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
+    return {localNz, offset,
+            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
+            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};
+}
+
+// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
+// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                                        const double invDx2, const double invDy2,
+                                        const double invDz2, const double gamma,
+                                        const double linearCoefficient,
+                                        const double constantCoefficient) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * plane;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+
+    for (std::size_t cell = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         cell < cells; cell += stride) {
+        const std::size_t inPlane = cell % plane;
+        const std::size_t x = inPlane % nx;
+        const std::size_t z = zBegin + cell / plane;
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = inPlane < nx ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = inPlane + nx >= plane ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) * invDx2 +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) * invDy2 +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value) * invDz2;
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            value * value * value + linearCoefficient * value + constantCoefficient - gamma * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(double* __restrict__ nextConcentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                             const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                             const double invDx2, const double invDy2,
+                             const double invDz2, const double dtTimesD) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * plane;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+
+    for (std::size_t cell = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         cell < cells; cell += stride) {
+        const std::size_t inPlane = cell % plane;
+        const std::size_t x = inPlane % nx;
+        const std::size_t z = zBegin + cell / plane;
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = inPlane < nx ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = inPlane + nx >= plane ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = chemicalPotential[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (chemicalPotential[left] + chemicalPotential[right] - 2.0 * value) * invDx2 +
+            (chemicalPotential[down] + chemicalPotential[up] - 2.0 * value) * invDy2 +
+            (chemicalPotential[center - plane] + chemicalPotential[center + plane] - 2.0 * value) * invDz2;
+
+        nextConcentration[center] = concentration[center] + dtTimesD * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+int launchBlockCount(const std::size_t cells, const int multiprocessors) {
+    const std::size_t required = (cells + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK;
+    const std::size_t occupancyCap = static_cast<std::size_t>(multiprocessors) * 8;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<std::size_t>(1, std::min(required, occupancyCap)));
+}
+
+void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
+                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                    const double invDx2, const double invDy2, const double invDz2,
+                    const double gamma, const double linearCoefficient,
+                    const double constantCoefficient, const int multiprocessors,
+                    cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, gamma, linearCoefficient, constantCoefficient);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const double invDx2,
+                  const double invDy2, const double invDz2,
+                  const double dtTimesD, const int multiprocessors,
+                  cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    updateKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dtTimesD);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+struct HaloRequests {
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+};
+
+HaloRequests postHaloExchange(double* field, const std::size_t plane,
+                              const std::size_t localNz, const Slab& slab) {
+    HaloRequests exchange{};
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(field, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, UPPER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[0]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                        slab.upperRank, LOWER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[1]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(field + plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, LOWER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[2]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(field + localNz * plane, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank,
+                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));
+    return exchange;
 }

+void finishHaloExchange(HaloRequests& exchange, double* field,
+                        const std::size_t plane, const Slab& slab,
+                        cudaStream_t stream) {
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(4, exchange.requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+
+    // MPI_PROC_NULL leaves a ghost plane untouched, so reproduce the original
+    // clamped z boundary by copying the nearest physical plane.
+    if (slab.lowerRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, plane * sizeof(double),
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
+    if (slab.upperRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (slab.localNz + 1) * plane,
+                                   field + slab.localNz * plane,
+                                   plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
 }

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
         }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
     }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;

+Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
+    return {localNz, offset,

+            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};

+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                                        const double invDx2, const double invDy2,
+                                        const double invDz2, const double gamma,
+                                        const double linearCoefficient,
+                                        const double constantCoefficient) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * plane;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+
+    for (std::size_t cell = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         cell < cells; cell += stride) {
+        const std::size_t inPlane = cell % plane;
+        const std::size_t x = inPlane % nx;
+        const std::size_t z = zBegin + cell / plane;
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = inPlane < nx ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = inPlane + nx >= plane ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) * invDx2 +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) * invDy2 +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value) * invDz2;
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            value * value * value + linearCoefficient * value + constantCoefficient - gamma * laplacian;
+    }

+                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,

+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;

+        const std::size_t down = inPlane < nx ? center : center - nx;

+                    const double gamma, const double linearCoefficient,
+                    const double constantCoefficient, const int multiprocessors,
+                    cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, gamma, linearCoefficient, constantCoefficient);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const double invDx2,
+                  const double invDy2, const double invDz2,
+                  const double dtTimesD, const int multiprocessors,
+                  cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::size_t cells = (zEnd - zBegin) * nx * ny;
+    updateKernel<<<launchBlockCount(cells, multiprocessors), THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd,
+        invDx2, invDy2, invDz2, dtTimesD);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}

+struct HaloRequests {
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+};
+
+struct HaloTransport {
+    bool cudaAware;
+    double* lowerReceive;
+    double* upperReceive;
+    double* lowerSend;
+    double* upperSend;
+};
+
+bool useCudaAwareMpi() {
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("CAHN_HILLIARD_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        return std::strcmp(overrideValue, "0") != 0;
+    }
+#if defined(CAHN_HILLIARD_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
+    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#else
+    // MPI has no portable capability query. Unknown implementations use the
+    // safe pinned path unless the cluster environment explicitly enables it.
+    return false;
+#endif
+}

+HaloRequests postHaloExchange(double* field, const std::size_t plane,
+                              const std::size_t localNz, const Slab& slab,
+                              const HaloTransport& transport, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    HaloRequests exchange{};
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);

+                                       plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+        }
+        if (slab.upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(transport.upperSend, upperSend,
+                                       plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
         }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+        lowerReceive = transport.lowerReceive;
+        upperReceive = transport.upperReceive;
+        lowerSend = transport.lowerSend;
+        upperSend = transport.upperSend;

-        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);
+
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(lowerReceive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, UPPER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[0]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(upperReceive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank, LOWER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[1]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(lowerSend, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, LOWER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[2]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(upperSend, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank,
+                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));

+}

+void finishHaloExchange(HaloRequests& exchange, double* field,
+                        const std::size_t plane, const Slab& slab,
+                        const HaloTransport& transport, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(4, exchange.requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));

+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));

+        // MPI_PROC_NULL leaves a ghost plane untouched, so reproduce the
+        // original clamped z boundary from the nearest physical plane.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, plane * sizeof(double),
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
     }
