+// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
+// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * E_AA + (value - 1.0) * E_BB -
+                   2.0 * value * E_AB) +
+            3.0 * value + value * value * value - GRADIENT_COEFFICIENT * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(double* __restrict__ nextConcentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                             const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = chemicalPotential[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (chemicalPotential[left] + chemicalPotential[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[down] + chemicalPotential[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[center - plane] + chemicalPotential[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        nextConcentration[center] = concentration[center] + DT_TIMES_DIFFUSION * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
+                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                    const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    updateKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}

+struct HaloRequests {
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+};
+
+struct HaloTransport {
+    bool cudaAware;
+    double* lowerReceive;
+    double* upperReceive;
+    double* lowerSend;
+    double* upperSend;
+};
+
+bool useCudaAwareMpi() {
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("CAHN_HILLIARD_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        return std::strcmp(overrideValue, "0") != 0;
+    }
+#if defined(CAHN_HILLIARD_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
+    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#else
+    // MPI has no portable capability query. Unknown implementations use the
+    // safe pinned path unless the cluster environment explicitly enables it.
+    return false;
+#endif
+}

+HaloRequests postHaloExchange(double* field, const std::size_t plane,
+                              const std::size_t localNz, const Slab& slab,
+                              const HaloTransport& transport, cudaStream_t haloStream) {
+    HaloRequests exchange{};
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
+    double* lowerReceive = field;

+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(transport.lowerSend, lowerSend,
+                                       plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, haloStream));
         }
+        if (slab.upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(transport.upperSend, upperSend,
+                                       plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, haloStream));
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(haloStream));
+        lowerReceive = transport.lowerReceive;
+        upperReceive = transport.upperReceive;
+        lowerSend = transport.lowerSend;
+        upperSend = transport.upperSend;
     }
-    
-    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field
-    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded
-    double minVal = c[0];
-    double maxVal = c[0];
-    for (const auto& val : c) {
-        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);
-        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);
+
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(lowerReceive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, UPPER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[0]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(upperReceive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank, LOWER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[1]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(lowerSend, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, LOWER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[2]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(upperSend, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank,
+                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));
+    return exchange;
+}

+void finishHaloExchange(HaloRequests& exchange, double* field,

+                        const HaloTransport& transport, cudaStream_t haloStream,

+        // original clamped z boundary from the nearest physical plane.

+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, haloStream));
     }

+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, haloStream));
+    } else if (slab.upperRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (slab.localNz + 1) * plane,

+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
+                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
+        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
+        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
+                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
+        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
+    }
 }
 
+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
+    }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
+}

+std::vector<double> gatherConcentration(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration,
+                                        const std::size_t plane, const std::size_t nz,
+                                        const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<double> globalConcentration;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+            const Slab sourceSlab = decomposeZ(nz, source, ranks);
+            const std::size_t count = sourceSlab.localNz * plane;
+            const std::size_t displacement = sourceSlab.globalZOffset * plane;
+            if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX) ||
+                displacement > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+                MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            }
+            counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(displacement);
+        }
+        globalConcentration.resize(plane * nz);
+    }
+
+    if (localConcentration.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "Local result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(localConcentration.data(), static_cast<int>(localConcentration.size()),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, rank == 0 ? globalConcentration.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return globalConcentration;
+}

+struct Slab {
+    std::size_t localNz;
+    std::size_t globalZOffset;
+    int lowerRank;
+    int upperRank;
+};
+
+Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
+    return {localNz, offset,
+            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
+            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};
+}
+
+// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
+// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * E_AA + (value - 1.0) * E_BB -
+                   2.0 * value * E_AB) +
+            3.0 * value + value * value * value - GRADIENT_COEFFICIENT * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(double* __restrict__ nextConcentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                             const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = chemicalPotential[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (chemicalPotential[left] + chemicalPotential[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[down] + chemicalPotential[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[center - plane] + chemicalPotential[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        nextConcentration[center] = concentration[center] + DT_TIMES_DIFFUSION * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
+                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                    const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    updateKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}

+struct HaloRequests {
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+};
+
+struct HaloTransport {
+    bool cudaAware;
+    double* lowerReceive;
+    double* upperReceive;
+    double* lowerSend;
+    double* upperSend;
+};
+
+bool useCudaAwareMpi() {
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("CAHN_HILLIARD_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        return std::strcmp(overrideValue, "0") != 0;
+    }
+#if defined(CAHN_HILLIARD_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
+    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#else
+    // MPI has no portable capability query. Unknown implementations use the
+    // safe pinned path unless the cluster environment explicitly enables it.
+    return false;
+#endif
+}
+
+HaloRequests postHaloExchange(double* field, const std::size_t plane,
+                              const std::size_t localNz, const Slab& slab,
+                              const HaloTransport& transport, cudaStream_t haloStream) {
+    HaloRequests exchange{};
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
+    double* lowerReceive = field;
+    double* upperReceive = field + (localNz + 1) * plane;
+    double* lowerSend = field + plane;
+    double* upperSend = field + localNz * plane;
+
+    if (!transport.cudaAware) {
+        if (slab.lowerRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(transport.lowerSend, lowerSend,
+                                       plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, haloStream));
         }
+        if (slab.upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(transport.upperSend, upperSend,
+                                       plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, haloStream));
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(haloStream));
+        lowerReceive = transport.lowerReceive;
+        upperReceive = transport.upperReceive;
+        lowerSend = transport.lowerSend;
+        upperSend = transport.upperSend;
     }
-    
-    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field
-    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded
-    double minVal = c[0];
-    double maxVal = c[0];
-    for (const auto& val : c) {
-        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);
-        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);
+
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(lowerReceive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, UPPER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[0]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(upperReceive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank, LOWER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[1]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(lowerSend, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, LOWER_TAG,
+                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[2]));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(upperSend, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank,
+                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));
+    return exchange;
+}
+
+void finishHaloExchange(HaloRequests& exchange, double* field,
+                        const std::size_t plane, const Slab& slab,
+                        const HaloTransport& transport, cudaStream_t haloStream,

+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
+                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
+        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
+        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
+                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
+        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
+    }
 }
 
+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
+    }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
+}

+std::vector<double> gatherConcentration(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration,
+                                        const std::size_t plane, const std::size_t nz,
+                                        const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<double> globalConcentration;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+            const Slab sourceSlab = decomposeZ(nz, source, ranks);
+            const std::size_t count = sourceSlab.localNz * plane;
+            const std::size_t displacement = sourceSlab.globalZOffset * plane;
+            if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX) ||
+                displacement > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+                MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            }
+            counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(displacement);
+        }
+        globalConcentration.resize(plane * nz);
+    }
+
+    if (localConcentration.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "Local result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(localConcentration.data(), static_cast<int>(localConcentration.size()),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, rank == 0 ? globalConcentration.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return globalConcentration;
+}

+struct Slab {
+    std::size_t localNz;
+    std::size_t globalZOffset;
+    int lowerRank;
+    int upperRank;
+};
+
+Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
+    return {localNz, offset,
+            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
+            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};
+}
+
+// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
+// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * E_AA + (value - 1.0) * E_BB -
+                   2.0 * value * E_AB) +
+            3.0 * value + value * value * value - GRADIENT_COEFFICIENT * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(double* __restrict__ nextConcentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                             const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = chemicalPotential[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (chemicalPotential[left] + chemicalPotential[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[down] + chemicalPotential[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[center - plane] + chemicalPotential[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        nextConcentration[center] = concentration[center] + DT_TIMES_DIFFUSION * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
+                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                    const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    updateKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}

+bool useCudaAwareMpi() {
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("CAHN_HILLIARD_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        return std::strcmp(overrideValue, "0") != 0;
+    }
+#if defined(CAHN_HILLIARD_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
+    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#else
+    // MPI has no portable capability query. Unknown implementations use the
+    // safe pinned path unless the cluster environment explicitly enables it.
+    return false;
+#endif
+}

+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
+                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
+        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
+        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
+                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
+        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
+    }

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
+    }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
+}

+std::vector<double> gatherConcentration(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration,
+                                        const std::size_t plane, const std::size_t nz,
+                                        const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<double> globalConcentration;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {

+struct Slab {
+    std::size_t localNz;
+    std::size_t globalZOffset;
+    int lowerRank;
+    int upperRank;
+};
+
+Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
+    return {localNz, offset,
+            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
+            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};
+}
+
+// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
+// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * E_AA + (value - 1.0) * E_BB -
+                   2.0 * value * E_AB) +
+            3.0 * value + value * value * value - GRADIENT_COEFFICIENT * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(double* __restrict__ nextConcentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                             const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = chemicalPotential[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (chemicalPotential[left] + chemicalPotential[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[down] + chemicalPotential[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[center - plane] + chemicalPotential[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        nextConcentration[center] = concentration[center] + DT_TIMES_DIFFUSION * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
+                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                    const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    updateKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}

+bool useCudaAwareMpi() {
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("CAHN_HILLIARD_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        return std::strcmp(overrideValue, "0") != 0;
+    }
+#if defined(CAHN_HILLIARD_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
+    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#else
+    // MPI has no portable capability query. Unknown implementations use the
+    // safe pinned path unless the cluster environment explicitly enables it.
+    return false;
+#endif
+}

+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
+                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
+        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
+        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
+                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
+        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
+    }
 }
 
+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
+    }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
+}

+std::vector<double> gatherConcentration(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration,
+                                        const std::size_t plane, const std::size_t nz,
+                                        const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<double> globalConcentration;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+        for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+            const Slab sourceSlab = decomposeZ(nz, source, ranks);
+            const std::size_t count = sourceSlab.localNz * plane;
+            const std::size_t displacement = sourceSlab.globalZOffset * plane;
+            if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX) ||
+                displacement > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+                MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            }
+            counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(displacement);
+        }
+        globalConcentration.resize(plane * nz);
+    }
+
+    if (localConcentration.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "Local result output exceeds MPI_Gatherv's count range\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(localConcentration.data(), static_cast<int>(localConcentration.size()),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, rank == 0 ? globalConcentration.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
+                          rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return globalConcentration;
+}

    37	void mpiCheck(const int error, const char* expression, const char* file, const int line) {
    38	    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) {
    39	        return;

    41	
    42	    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
    43	    int length = 0;
    44	    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
    45	    int rank = -1;
    46	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
    47	    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: MPI error at %s:%d in %s: %.*s\n",
    48	                 rank, file, line, expression, length, message);
    49	    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
    50	}

    70	    }
    71	    result = a * b;
    72	    return true;

   115	Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
   116	    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
   117	    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
   118	    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
   119	    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
   120	    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
   121	    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
   122	    return {localNz, offset,
   123	            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
   124	            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};
   125	}
   126	
   127	// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
   128	// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
   129	__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
   130	                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
   131	                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
   132	                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
   133	    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
   134	    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   135	    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
   136	    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
   137	        return;
   138	    }
   139	
   140	    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
   141	    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
   142	        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
   143	        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
   144	        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
   145	        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
   146	        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
   147	        const double value = concentration[center];
   148	        const double laplacian =
   149	            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) +
   150	            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) +
   151	            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
   152	
   153	        chemicalPotential[center] =
   154	            4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * E_AA + (value - 1.0) * E_BB -
   155	                   2.0 * value * E_AB) +
   156	            3.0 * value + value * value * value - GRADIENT_COEFFICIENT * laplacian;
   157	    }
   158	}
   159	
   160	__global__ void updateKernel(double* __restrict__ nextConcentration,
   161	                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,
   162	                             const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
   163	                             const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
   164	                             const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
   165	    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
   166	    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   167	    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
   168	    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
   169	        return;
   170	    }
   171	
   172	    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
   173	    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
   174	        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
   175	        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
   176	        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
   177	        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
   178	        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
   179	        const double value = chemicalPotential[center];
   180	        const double laplacian =
   181	            (chemicalPotential[left] + chemicalPotential[right] - 2.0 * value) +
   182	            (chemicalPotential[down] + chemicalPotential[up] - 2.0 * value) +
   183	            (chemicalPotential[center - plane] + chemicalPotential[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
   184	
   185	        nextConcentration[center] = concentration[center] + DT_TIMES_DIFFUSION * laplacian;
   186	    }
   187	}
   188	
   189	void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
   190	                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
   191	                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
   192	                    const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
   193	    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
   194	        return;
   195	    }
   196	    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
   197	    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
   198	                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
   199	                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
   200	                                                                      maxGridZ)));
   201	    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
   202	        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
   203	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
   204	}
   205	
   206	void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
   207	                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
   208	                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
   209	                  const std::size_t zEnd, const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
   210	    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
   211	        return;
   212	    }
   213	    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
   214	    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
   215	                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
   216	                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
   217	                                                                      maxGridZ)));
   218	    updateKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
   219	        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
   220	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
   221	}

   227	struct HaloTransport {
   228	    bool cudaAware;
   229	    double* lowerReceive;
   230	    double* upperReceive;
   230	    double* upperReceive;
   231	    double* lowerSend;
   232	    double* upperSend;
   233	};

   235	bool useCudaAwareMpi() {
   236	    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("CAHN_HILLIARD_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
   237	    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
   238	        return std::strcmp(overrideValue, "0") != 0;
   239	    }
   240	#if defined(CAHN_HILLIARD_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
   241	    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
   242	#else
   243	    // MPI has no portable capability query. Unknown implementations use the
   244	    // safe pinned path unless the cluster environment explicitly enables it.
   245	    return false;
   246	#endif
   247	}
   248	
   249	HaloRequests postHaloExchange(double* field, const std::size_t plane,
   250	                              const std::size_t localNz, const Slab& slab,
   251	                              const HaloTransport& transport, cudaStream_t haloStream) {
   252	    HaloRequests exchange{};
   253	    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
   254	    double* lowerReceive = field;
   255	    double* upperReceive = field + (localNz + 1) * plane;
   256	    double* lowerSend = field + plane;
   257	    double* upperSend = field + localNz * plane;
   258	
   259	    if (!transport.cudaAware) {
   260	        if (slab.lowerRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   261	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(transport.lowerSend, lowerSend,
   262	                                       plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, haloStream));
   263	        }
   264	        if (slab.upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   265	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(transport.upperSend, upperSend,
   266	                                       plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, haloStream));
   267	        }
   268	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(haloStream));
   269	        lowerReceive = transport.lowerReceive;
   270	        upperReceive = transport.upperReceive;
   271	        lowerSend = transport.lowerSend;
   272	        upperSend = transport.upperSend;
   273	    }
   274	
   275	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(lowerReceive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, UPPER_TAG,
   276	                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[0]));
   277	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(upperReceive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank, LOWER_TAG,
   278	                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[1]));
   279	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(lowerSend, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.lowerRank, LOWER_TAG,
   280	                        MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[2]));
   281	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(upperSend, count, MPI_DOUBLE, slab.upperRank,
   282	                        UPPER_TAG, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &exchange.requests[3]));
   283	    return exchange;
   284	}
   285	
   286	void finishHaloExchange(HaloRequests& exchange, double* field,
   287	                        const std::size_t plane, const Slab& slab,
   288	                        const HaloTransport& transport, cudaStream_t haloStream,
   289	                        cudaStream_t computeStream, cudaEvent_t haloReady) {
   290	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(4, exchange.requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
   291	
   292	    if (slab.lowerRank != MPI_PROC_NULL && !transport.cudaAware) {
   293	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, transport.lowerReceive, plane * sizeof(double),
   294	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, haloStream));
   295	    } else if (slab.lowerRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   296	        // MPI_PROC_NULL leaves a ghost plane untouched, so reproduce the
   297	        // original clamped z boundary from the nearest physical plane.
   298	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, plane * sizeof(double),
   299	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, haloStream));
   300	    }
   301	    if (slab.upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL && !transport.cudaAware) {
   302	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (slab.localNz + 1) * plane,
   303	                                   transport.upperReceive, plane * sizeof(double),
   304	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, haloStream));
   305	    } else if (slab.upperRank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   306	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (slab.localNz + 1) * plane,
   307	                                   field + slab.localNz * plane,
   308	                                   plane * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, haloStream));
   309	    }
   310	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(haloReady, haloStream));
   311	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(computeStream, haloReady, 0));
   312	}
   313	
   314	void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
   315	                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
   316	                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
   317	    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
   318	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   319	    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
   320	        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
   321	        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
   322	                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
   323	        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
   324	    }
   325	}
   326	
   327	bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
   328	    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
   329	    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
   330	    int localInvalid = 0;
   331	    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
   332	
   333	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
   334	    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
   335	        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
   336	        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
   337	        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
   338	        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
   339	    }
   340	
   341	    double globalMin = 0.0;
   342	    double globalMax = 0.0;
   343	    int globalInvalid = 0;
   344	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   345	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   346	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   347	
   348	    if (rank == 0) {
   349	        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
   350	            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
   351	        }
   352	        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
   353	        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
   354	            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   355	        }
   356	    }
   357	    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
   358	}
   359	
   360	std::vector<double> gatherConcentration(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration,
   361	                                        const std::size_t plane, const std::size_t nz,
   362	                                        const int rank, const int ranks) {
   363	    std::vector<int> counts;
   364	    std::vector<int> displacements;
   365	    std::vector<double> globalConcentration;
   366	    if (rank == 0) {
   367	        counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
   368	        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
   369	        for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
   370	            const Slab sourceSlab = decomposeZ(nz, source, ranks);
   490	
   491	    MPI_Comm localCommunicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   492	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank,
   493	                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &localCommunicator));
   494	    int localRank = 0;
   495	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(localCommunicator, &localRank));
   496	
   497	    int deviceCount = 0;
   498	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
   499	    if (deviceCount == 0) {
   500	        if (rank == 0) {
   501	            std::fprintf(stderr, "No CUDA devices are visible\n");
   502	        }
   503	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   504	    }
   505	    const int device = localRank % deviceCount;
   506	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
   507	    cudaDeviceProp deviceProperties{};
   508	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&deviceProperties, device));
   509	
   510	    int cudaAware = useCudaAwareMpi() ? 1 : 0;
   511	    int allCudaAware = 0;
   512	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&cudaAware, &allCudaAware, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   513	    HaloTransport haloTransport{allCudaAware != 0, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr};
   514	    double* hostHaloStorage = nullptr;
   515	    if (!haloTransport.cudaAware) {
   516	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hostHaloStorage, 4 * plane * sizeof(double)));
   517	        haloTransport.lowerReceive = hostHaloStorage;
   518	        haloTransport.upperReceive = hostHaloStorage + plane;
   519	        haloTransport.lowerSend = hostHaloStorage + 2 * plane;
   520	        haloTransport.upperSend = hostHaloStorage + 3 * plane;
   521	    }
   522	
   523	    if (rank == 0) {
   524	        std::printf("Cahn-Hilliard Phase Separation Benchmark\n");
   525	        std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
   526	        std::printf("Time steps: %d\n", iterations);
   527	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   528	        std::printf("Hybrid execution: %d MPI rank(s), up to %d OpenMP thread(s)/rank, CUDA GPUs\n",
   529	                    ranks, omp_get_max_threads());
   530	        std::printf("Rank 0 CUDA device: %s\n", deviceProperties.name);
   531	        std::printf("MPI GPU transport: %s\n",
   532	                    haloTransport.cudaAware ? "CUDA-aware direct" : "pinned-host staged");
   533	        std::printf("Initializing concentration field...\n");
   534	    }
   535	
   536	    std::vector<double> localConcentration(localCells);
   537	    initializeConcentration(localConcentration, slab.globalZOffset * plane, gridSize);
   538	
   539	    double* deviceConcentration = nullptr;
   540	    double* deviceNext = nullptr;
   541	    double* deviceChemicalPotential = nullptr;
   542	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceConcentration, allocatedCells * sizeof(double)));
   543	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceNext, allocatedCells * sizeof(double)));
   544	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceChemicalPotential, allocatedCells * sizeof(double)));
   545	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceConcentration + plane, localConcentration.data(),
   546	                          localCells * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   547	
   548	    cudaStream_t computeStream = nullptr;
   549	    cudaStream_t haloStream = nullptr;
   550	    cudaEvent_t haloReady = nullptr;
   551	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&computeStream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   552	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&haloStream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   553	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&haloReady, cudaEventDisableTiming));
   554	
   555	    if (rank == 0) {
   556	        std::printf("Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\n");
   557	    }
   558	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   559	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   560	
   561	    for (int step = 0; step < iterations; ++step) {
   562	        // Ensure the previous update is visible before CUDA-aware MPI reads it.
   563	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream));
   564	        HaloRequests concentrationExchange =
   565	            postHaloExchange(deviceConcentration, plane, slab.localNz, slab,
   566	                             haloTransport, haloStream);
   567	
   568	        // z=[2, localNz) never consumes a ghost plane and overlaps halo traffic.
   569	        launchChemical(deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny, 2,
   570	                       slab.localNz, deviceProperties.maxGridSize[2], computeStream);
   571	        finishHaloExchange(concentrationExchange, deviceConcentration, plane, slab,
   572	                           haloTransport, haloStream, computeStream, haloReady);
   573	        launchChemical(deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny, 1, 2,
   574	                       deviceProperties.maxGridSize[2], computeStream);
   575	        if (slab.localNz > 1) {
   576	            launchChemical(deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny,
   577	                           slab.localNz, slab.localNz + 1,
   578	                           deviceProperties.maxGridSize[2], computeStream);
   579	        }
   580	
   581	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream));
   582	        HaloRequests potentialExchange =
   583	            postHaloExchange(deviceChemicalPotential, plane, slab.localNz, slab,
   584	                             haloTransport, haloStream);
   585	
   586	        launchUpdate(deviceNext, deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential,
   587	                     nx, ny, 2, slab.localNz,
   588	                     deviceProperties.maxGridSize[2], computeStream);
   589	        finishHaloExchange(potentialExchange, deviceChemicalPotential, plane, slab,
   590	                           haloTransport, haloStream, computeStream, haloReady);
   591	        launchUpdate(deviceNext, deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential,
   592	                     nx, ny, 1, 2,
   593	                     deviceProperties.maxGridSize[2], computeStream);
   594	        if (slab.localNz > 1) {
   595	            launchUpdate(deviceNext, deviceConcentration, deviceChemicalPotential,
   596	                         nx, ny, slab.localNz, slab.localNz + 1,
   597	                         deviceProperties.maxGridSize[2], computeStream);
   598	        }
   599	        std::swap(deviceConcentration, deviceNext);
   600	    }
   601	
   602	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream));
   603	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   604	    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   605	    double elapsed = 0.0;
   606	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   607	
   608	    if (rank == 0) {
   609	        const long long milliseconds = static_cast<long long>(elapsed * 1000.0);
   610	        const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(gridSize) * iterations;
   611	        const double mcups = elapsed > 0.0 ? cellUpdates / elapsed / 1.0e6 : 0.0;
   612	        std::printf("Computation time: %lld ms\n", milliseconds);
   613	        std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   614	    }
   615	
   616	    if (printResults || validate) {
   617	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localConcentration.data(), deviceConcentration + plane,
   618	                              localCells * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   619	    }
   620	
   621	    if (printResults) {
   622	        std::vector<double> globalConcentration =
   623	            gatherConcentration(localConcentration, plane, nz, rank, ranks);
   624	        if (rank == 0) {
   625	            print_results(globalConcentration, "Concentration");
   626	        }
   627	    }
   628	
   629	    bool valid = true;
   630	    if (validate) {
   631	        if (rank == 0) {
   632	            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   633	        }
   634	        valid = validateDistributed(localConcentration, rank);
   635	        if (rank == 0) {
   636	            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   637	        }
   638	    }
   639	
   640	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(haloReady));
   641	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(haloStream));
   642	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(computeStream));
   643	    if (hostHaloStorage != nullptr) {
   644	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostHaloStorage));
   645	    }
   646	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceChemicalPotential));
   647	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceNext));
   648	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceConcentration));
   649	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator));
   650	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());

+struct Slab {
+    std::size_t localNz;
+    std::size_t globalZOffset;
+    int lowerRank;
+    int upperRank;
+};
+
+Slab decomposeZ(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t localNz = base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const std::size_t offset = rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder);
+    return {localNz, offset,
+            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
+            rank == ranks - 1 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};
+}
+
+// Both stencils operate on local z slabs with one ghost plane on either side.
+// x and y retain the original clamped (zero normal derivative) boundaries.
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = concentration[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (concentration[left] + concentration[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[down] + concentration[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (concentration[center - plane] + concentration[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        chemicalPotential[center] =
+            4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * E_AA + (value - 1.0) * E_BB -
+                   2.0 * value * E_AB) +
+            3.0 * value + value * value * value - GRADIENT_COEFFICIENT * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(double* __restrict__ nextConcentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                             const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t x = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t inPlane = y * nx + x;
+    for (std::size_t z = zBegin + blockIdx.z; z < zEnd; z += gridDim.z) {
+        const std::size_t center = z * plane + inPlane;
+        const std::size_t left = x == 0 ? center : center - 1;
+        const std::size_t right = x + 1 == nx ? center : center + 1;
+        const std::size_t down = y == 0 ? center : center - nx;
+        const std::size_t up = y + 1 == ny ? center : center + nx;
+        const double value = chemicalPotential[center];
+        const double laplacian =
+            (chemicalPotential[left] + chemicalPotential[right] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[down] + chemicalPotential[up] - 2.0 * value) +
+            (chemicalPotential[center - plane] + chemicalPotential[center + plane] - 2.0 * value);
+
+        nextConcentration[center] = concentration[center] + DT_TIMES_DIFFUSION * laplacian;
+    }
+}
+
+void launchChemical(const double* concentration, double* chemicalPotential,
+                    const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                    const std::size_t zBegin, const std::size_t zEnd,
+                    const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}
+
+void launchUpdate(double* nextConcentration, const double* concentration,
+                  const double* chemicalPotential, const std::size_t nx,
+                  const std::size_t ny, const std::size_t zBegin,
+                  const std::size_t zEnd, const int maxGridZ, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const dim3 threads(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y, 1);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y),
+                      static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<std::size_t>(zEnd - zBegin,
+                                                                      maxGridZ)));
+    updateKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+        nextConcentration, concentration, chemicalPotential, nx, ny, zBegin, zEnd);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaPeekAtLastError());
+}

+bool useCudaAwareMpi() {
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("CAHN_HILLIARD_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        return std::strcmp(overrideValue, "0") != 0;
+    }
+#if defined(CAHN_HILLIARD_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
+    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#else
+    // MPI has no portable capability query. Unknown implementations use the
+    // safe pinned path unless the cluster environment explicitly enables it.
+    return false;
+#endif
+}

+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const std::size_t globalOffset,
+                             const std::size_t globalVolume) {
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(concentration.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (long long local = 0; local < cells; ++local) {
+        const std::size_t linearId = globalOffset + static_cast<std::size_t>(local);
+        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * std::size_t{1299709} % globalVolume) /
+                              static_cast<double>(globalVolume);
+        concentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(local)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
+    }
 }
 
+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& localConcentration, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long cells = static_cast<long long>(localConcentration.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < cells; ++i) {
+        const double value = localConcentration[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+        }
+    }
+    return globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 10.0 && globalMin >= -10.0;
+}
